map.Base64 每 3 字节编码为 4 字符字符数 = ⌈n/3⌉ × 4，末尾按: Base64 encodes every 3 bytes into 4 characters, so the character count = ceil(n/3) x 4, with 2 padding chars for a remainder of 1 and 1 for a remainder of 2, using =
